background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: The group is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 3 May 2023. Capital is on the weak side of US banks, with CET1 of 11.2% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.5% below the peer median, and liquidity likewise, with LCR of 112% below the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026. The newest flagged item, on 20 Sep 2026, is a fraud-education programme rather than a credit event; the earlier warning about larger unrealised losses on its bond holdings as yields rise is the main watch point for a bank whose ratios already sit below its peers.
